items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. And also, Basie's band, with Freddie Green, and whoever the bass player was. [INTERVIEWEE] Right.

ctx.x: Right, well, when you talk about drums and things, drum -- Basie is a good example of that. I mean, his style, and he had to have that certain type of a drummer who shades. He shades. He can play, but he's very effective, but he's almost not heard at one time. This type -- and then if he wants to build, he's got the whole world to build on, because he can go to the limits. And so this is why they're so explosive, you would call it.
Yeah. And also, Basie's band, with Freddie Green, and whoever the bass player was.
